about: Sites the as-data checker sees but does not count: a string literal that spells a content id but is not one. One entry per (file, literal) with a one-line reason; it covers every occurrence of that literal in that file. The checker lists these separately, and an entry whose site no longer exists is STALE and fails (tests/as-data-check.test.ts), so this list cannot rot. `verbs` are closed lists kept in code on purpose (an id scheme with its own parser, generator geometry, a row schema): each names its dispatch and its sunset, is listed apart and never counted, and a verb whose declaration is gone fails the run.
